'''Ruthbert Ozzel''' was an officer who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Waymancy Storm]]. During the conflict, they earned the sobriquet "the Savior of [[Mittoblade/Legends|Mittoblade]]". A scion of the [[Ozzel family/Legends|Ozzel family]], they were a distant ancestor of [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
